content:
Team A has a manager. Team B has a leader.

Team A: one lit candle at the top. Manager knows everything. TL knows some. L1 finds out last, if at all.

Team B: every candle stays lit. The leader doesn't hoard the flame passes it forward, every time.

Hoarding information doesn't make you powerful. It makes your team weaker and more dependent on you.

Helping others shine doesn't dim your own flame.

Which team have you worked on — A or B?
